title: matricaria rupestris
intro: Matricaria rupestris, commonly known as Stoneflower or Rock marigold, is a flowering plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Matricaria rupestris include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
